metrics.label: SHA-256 hashing
metrics.description: Streams SHA-256 over a seeded 32 MiB buffer eight times per round in Node, each pass and round under its own prefix, in rounds for at least a second, and reports hashing throughput.

metrics.label: gzip roundtrip
metrics.description: Compresses and decompresses a seeded 8 MiB JSON corpus with zlib, salted differently each round, in rounds for at least a second, and checks every round's roundtrip digest and gzip CRC-32.

metrics.label: JSON parse and walk
metrics.description: Parses, walks and re-serializes a seeded 1 MiB package-graph JSON document 40 times in Node.

metrics.label: Prime sieve
metrics.description: Runs a segmented sieve of Eratosthenes over a 16-million-number window above 100 million, a new non-overlapping window each round, and hashes every prime found, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: Fix a Node bug
metrics.description: Writes a seeded Node ESM project (untimed), then sees node --test fail, fixes two bugs with file edits, and reruns the tests.

metrics.label: Fix a Python bug
metrics.description: Writes a seeded Python package (untimed), then sees unittest fail, fixes the ledger bug with a file edit, and reruns the tests.

metrics.label: Codemod rename
metrics.description: Writes 40 chained ES modules (untimed), then renames an exported function across them with a codemod and imports every module to check the result.

metrics.label: Log triage
metrics.description: Generates 30,000 seeded JSONL service log lines with an error spike (untimed), then inspects them and finds the failing service and its p95 latency.

metrics.label: 50 commands in a row
metrics.description: Runs 50 short commands one after another, each hashing the previous reply in the guest, as a tool-calling agent does.

metrics.label: 16 commands at once
metrics.description: Starts 16 commands in one sandbox at the same time, each deriving a token and writing its own file, then checks every file.

metrics.label: Search a repo
metrics.description: Searches a seeded 150-file repo with grep and find, then reads each matching file to confirm the 12 hidden markers.

metrics.label: Edit and test, 8 times
metrics.description: Edits a feature flag and its test expectation, then runs node --test, eight times over, as an agent iterating on a change.

metrics.label: 500 small files
metrics.description: Create 500 seeded source files across 20 directories, list and read every one back, hash the manifest and delete the tree, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: SQLite OLTP
metrics.description: SQLite on a disk file in WAL mode: 2,500 batched inserts, 500 indexed lookups, 250 updates, an aggregate and an integrity check, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: tar pack and extract
metrics.description: Pack a seeded 6.4 MB, 120-file project with tar -czf, extract it to a clean directory and compare every byte, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: SDK file transfer
metrics.description: Write 20 seeded files of 1 to 64 KiB through box.files.write, read each back byte-exact with box.files.read, and check the guest's copy.

metrics.label: TypeScript strip and bundle
metrics.description: Generate a 30-module TypeScript project (enums, generics, unions), then strip types with Node's built-in transformer, bundle it into one file and run it, in rounds for at least a second; reports the median round.

metrics.label: Python bytecode build
metrics.description: Generate a 60-module Python package, then compile it with python3 -m compileall and import and run its entry point from bytecode, in rounds for at least a second; reports the median round.

metrics.label: git branch and merge
metrics.description: Local git: init, 20 commits across main and two feature branches, two no-ff merges, log, diff and a clean status check, in rounds for at least a second; reports the median round.

metrics.label: Local HTTP server load
metrics.description: Serve seeded HMAC JSON from a Node HTTP server on an ephemeral port and drive 200 keep-alive fetches from 50 concurrent clients, checking every response, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: 128 MiB memory touch
metrics.description: Allocate a 128 MiB working set, write every 4 KiB page with seeded words, then read it back with a full XOR pass and a strided checksum, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: Spawn 100 processes
metrics.description: Spawn 100 short-lived /bin/sh children one after another, each printing a seeded token and its own pid, and check every exit code, output and pid, in rounds for at least a second.

metrics.label: stdout streaming
metrics.description: Stream 7,500 seeded lines (about 0.5 MB) through box.run stdout, in rounds for at least a second, and check every line arrived intact and untruncated.

metrics.label: Env, cwd, files, processes
metrics.description: Check per-command env and its isolation, absolute and relative cwd, binary and UTF-8 file round trips, and stopping a background process.
